records.people: Kateryna Rozhkova (Director of the NBU Off-Site Supervision Department for six months in 2009; Director of the Banking Supervision Department 10 June 2015 to 18 January 2016; acting Deputy Governor from 18 January 2016; Deputy Governor from 25 October 2016; First Deputy Governor from 15 June 2018)
records.move: from acting chair of the board of Platinum Bank PJSC, and earlier deputy chair of the board, board member and adviser to the chair at ErsteBank PJSC and deputy chair of the board at Finbank PJSC, to Director of the Banking Supervision Department of the National Bank of Ukraine on 10 June 2015, then acting Deputy Governor (18 January 2016), Deputy Governor (25 October 2016) and First Deputy Governor (15 June 2018)
records.summary: The National Bank of Ukraine's own biography page for its First Deputy Governor lists, before any central bank post, managerial positions in Ukraine's banking system from 1998 and three named bank employers - ErsteBank PJSC, Finbank PJSC and Platinum Bank PJSC, where she was acting chair of the board - and then the NBU supervisory posts with the dates given above. The private side rests on a second source named here, not on the NBU page, which states only the legal form PJSC: the Kyiv Post, 'The Woman Behind Ukraine's Banking Cleanup: Kateryna Rozhkova (Part I)', https://www.kyivpost.com/post/66155, says she came to the NBU 'from a private-sector manager', that 'Before joining the NBU, she led Platinum Bank, the 22nd largest bank by assets in Ukraine in October 2016', that she 'led the bank up to mid-2015', that the bank was owned indirectly by Odesa entrepreneur Borys Kaufman, and that Platinum collapsed in 2017 - a named private owner. All dates above are printed on the NBU page; the 1998 start, the Kaufman ownership and the 2017 collapse come from the Kyiv Post article. The NBU page is a numbered slot URL (?member=10) and was opened on 17 November 2026 and confirmed to serve Rozhkova's own page; it describes the First Deputy Governor post as one she still holds, which this record does not assert, since press reports of her replacement by Serhii Nikolaichuk were returned by the same search.
records.source_title: Financial Stability - Kateryna Rozhkova, First Deputy Governor (National Bank of Ukraine, official biography)

records.people: Mikhail Yurievich Alekseev (Chairman of the Management Board of AO UniCredit Bank from July 2008; left its Management Board in 2020; Deputy Chairman of the Bank of Russia)
records.move: from Chairman of the Management Board of AO UniCredit Bank, Moscow, to Deputy Chairman of the Bank of Russia, overseeing the cash circulation department and ROSINKAS and planned to chair the board of directors of the Management Company of the Banking Sector Consolidation Fund
records.summary: Interfax reports that Mikhail Alekseev, chairman of the management board of UniCredit Bank, will move to the Bank of Russia as a deputy chairman, that the regulator said he would take up the post 'from 12 October', that he had led UniCredit Bank since 2008, chaired the board of Rosprombank from 2006 to 2008, and earlier was deputy chairman of the board and vice president at Rosbank and worked at the Onexim group and Mezhkombank, having begun at the USSR Ministry of Finance. The private side is settled by a second source named here, the employer's own filing: AO UniCredit Bank, Issuer's Annual Report 2019, https://www.unicreditbank.ru/content/dam/cee2020-pws-ru/issuer-reports/issuer-info/emission-annual-reports/issuer_annual_report_2019.pdf, states '100% of the voting shares of AO UniCredit Bank belong to the UniCredit Group (UniCredit S.p.A.)', so the employer is a wholly owned subsidiary of the listed Italian group UniCredit S.p.A., a party the map already carries; the same report's section 10 says that in July 2008 he was appointed Chairman of the Management Board of UniCredit Bank by decision of the Supervisory Board. The year of the move is taken from the same series: the Issuer's Annual Report 2020 states that in 2020 Mikhail Yurievich Alekseev left the Management Board. The Interfax text read here carries the day and month '12 October' but no year, and no year is asserted here from it.
records.source_title: Mikhail Alekseev of UniCredit Bank to become a deputy chairman of the Central Bank (Interfax)

records.people: Carlos Carvallo Spalding (member of the Board of the Banco Central del Paraguay and alternate governor for Paraguay at the IMF, 2015 to 2020; president of Financiera Ueno from March 2022)
records.move: from full member of the Board of the Banco Central del Paraguay (2015-2020) to the private sector as president of the financial institution Ueno from March 2022, and then back to head the Banco Central del Paraguay
records.summary: Ultima Hora reports that Carlos Carvallo returns to the Banco Central del Paraguay after his time in the private sector, having served there 'como miembro titular del Directorio y gobernador alterno ante el Fondo Monetario internacional (FMI), de 2015 a 2020', and that he was president of the financial institution Ueno from March 2022 until the article was published, Ueno being the last institution where he served. The outside employer is private on the face of the report, which calls the move a move to 'el sector privado', and it is financial, the article describing Ueno as 'la entidad financiera Ueno' rather than as a bank; this record does not call it a bank. The article reports his return to head the BCP under the government of Santiago Pena and gives no start date for that return, so none is stated here. This is a different person, a different employer and different years from the record the map already holds for Paraguay, Carlos Fernandez Valdovinos moving from the BCP presidency to the board of Banco Basa.
records.source_title: Carlos Carvallo vuelve al BCP tras su paso por el sector privado (Ultima Hora)

records.people: Oraz Zhandosov (chairman of the National Bank of Kazakhstan, no dates given on the cited page; member of the board of directors and independent director of ForteBank from 21 April 2026)
records.move: from chairman of the National Bank of Kazakhstan to member of the board of directors and independent director of ForteBank, elected at the bank's annual general meeting of shareholders, with a term running to the 2028 annual general meeting
records.summary: Bes.media, in an article dated 21 April 2026, reports that Oraz Zhandosov was elected a member of the board of directors and independent director of ForteBank at the bank's annual general meeting of shareholders, holding the post since 21 April, with the whole board's term expiring at the 2028 annual general meeting, and that he has held the posts of chairman of the National Bank, first deputy prime minister and deputy prime minister of Kazakhstan 'in different years' - the page gives no dates for those posts, so none are stated here, and the only date it attaches to his earlier career is that in the early 2000s he headed KEGOC, the national electricity grid company. The article does not state ForteBank's ownership, so the private side rests on a second source named here: finance.kz, 'Bulat Utemuratov strengthens his position in ForteBank: stake grew to 90.92%', https://finance.kz/news/bulat-utemuratov-ukreplyaet-pozitsii-v-fortebank-dolya-vyrosla-do-90-92-na-fone-priobreteniya-home-credit-bank, which states that 'the largest shareholder of ForteBank Bulat Utemuratov significantly increased his stake in the financial institution - to 90.92%' as at 1 July 2025 according to the shareholder register extract, naming a private individual majority shareholder. That article calls him a businessman and does not use the words private person. Both legs rest on press rather than on a primary document, and the dates of the National Bank chairmanship are absent from both, so this is flagged as a weak source. It is a different person and a different employer from the record the map already holds for Kazakhstan, Grigory Marchenko moving to Halyk Bank.
records.source_title: Oraz Zhandosov elected an independent director of ForteBank (Bes.media)

blanks.read: Produbanco (Banco de la Produccion S.A.) publishes one hoja-de-vida PDF per director, and the record the map already holds for Ecuador is one of them (Juan Diego Mosquera Pesantes, media/711146). Six further CVs from the same series were downloaded in full and grepped for 'Banco Central' and 'Superintendencia de Banco': hoja-de-vida-pablo-mauricio-arguello-godoy.pdf (media/711148), hoja-de-vida-gustavo-francisco-vasconez-espinosa.pdf (711144), hoja-de-vida-hector-roberto-neira-calderon.pdf (711145), hoja-de-vida-carlos-francisco-rodriguez-vasconez.pdf (711139), hoja-de-vida-diego-javier-borrero-andrade.pdf (711141) and juan-manuel-borrero-viver-espanol-vf-90.pdf (713672). All six extract clean text and all six list full dated career histories - Banco Promerica, Sociedad Financiera Promerica, Banco MM Jaramillo Arteaga, Lloyds TSB Bank Plc, ING Barings, Citibank N.A., Mastercard International, Banco Finca S.A., Unicredit S.A. Guayaquil, Grupo Banco Popular - and not one of them names the Banco Central del Ecuador or the Superintendencia de Bancos. The vein is private-bank CVs at one issuer and it is now read out for the directors a search surfaces; the untried neighbour is the same bank's 'memoria financiera' PDFs, which carry the shareholder table and officer CVs together.

The Central Bank of the Republic of China's CV table for the 21st Board of Directors was opened. Three of the search hits on cbc.gov.tw are the SAME table in three file formats, not three documents: dl-213959 is a Microsoft Word CDF file, dl-213960 is an OpenDocument file whose content.xml was extracted in full, and dl-213961 is the PDF that is already the source of the record the map holds. The table lists 15 directors with their principal post. Only two principal posts are in finance: 陳思寬 (Chen Szu-kuan), chairman of SinoPac Financial Holdings and SinoPac Securities Investment Trust, which is the record already filed, and 董瑞斌, a new director and managing director whose principal post is given as chairman of Mega Financial Holding Company Limited and Mega International Commercial Bank Company Limited. Refused: the table states no ownership for Mega, and Mega is widely state-linked, so filing it would either assert private finance on no evidence or be a public_move that does not count. One further director, 吳明昌, chairs Taiwan Sugar Corporation, which is not financial. Note on metadata, since none was used for a date: dl-213959's CDF header carries Create Time 8 January 2025, Last Printed 20 January 2025, Last Saved 20 January 2025, revision 10; no date in this entry comes from any of those fields.

Centralna banka Crne Gore official biography page for Vice-Governor Zorica Kalezic, PhD, https://www.cbcg.me/en/vicegovernors/zorica-kalezic-phd, read in full. Her career list is entirely public sector and multilateral: vice-governor of the CBCG since 2019, external member of the CBCG Council 2018-2019, adviser to the Executive Director of the Dutch-Belgian constituency at the IMF 2015-2018 and at the World Bank 2013-2015, special adviser to the chief economist and vice-governor 2007-2013, chief negotiator for Chapter 17 2012-2014, secretary of the external Experts Council of Montenegro 2013. No commercial bank, no private financial firm, no private employer of any kind. The vein - the bank's own per-official biography pages at cbcg.me/en/vicegovernors/ and /en/<name> - is the same host as the record the map already holds (Radoje Zugic), and the other officials' pages on it were not opened for want of budget.

No document opened. A Spanish search for an ex-codirector of the Banco de la Republica joining a private bank board returned only the arrival and departure of codirectors: the January 2025 appointments of Laura Moisa and Cesar/Carlos Giraldo, the removal of Steiner and Jaramillo, and the Banco de la Republica's own welcome notices at banrep.gov.co/es/noticias/junta-directiva/banrep-bienvenida-nuevos-miembros-2025. None of the incoming codirectors comes from private finance on the face of those reports. Colombia has NOT been tested on this row: the route not opened is the bank's own per-codirector profile pages at banrep.gov.co/es/<name>, which is the host of the record the map already counts as public (Leonardo Villar from the IMF), and the departures of Carolina Soto and Jaime Jaramillo, whose next employers were not searched.

A Vietnamese-language search for the career phrase 'nguyen Pho Thong doc Ngan hang Nha nuoc' alongside 'hoi dong quan tri ngan hang thuong mai co phan' returned almost nothing but legal instruments - the State Bank's circulars and consolidated texts on approving the prospective personnel of commercial banks (Circular 22/2018/TT-NHNN and its consolidations, Law on Credit Institutions 32/2024/QH15, Decrees 49/2000 and 59/2009) - which name a mechanism for vetting bank directors and no person. The phrase route is closed in that form. One lead surfaced and was not filed: vnba.org.vn reports Vietcombank chairman Pham Quang Dung becoming a Deputy Governor of the State Bank of Vietnam, but Vietcombank is a state-majority joint stock bank, so that would be a public_move and would not count; the article was not opened and the stake was not checked.

The lead was Al Salam Bank's own board profile for Anwar Mohammed Murad, surfaced by search as https://www.alsalambank.com/en/?p=1480. Fetched and it is the quiet failure the common brief warns about: a 200 serving the site homepage rather than the profile - 'Leading Islamic Retail Bank in Bahrain', 'Licensed and Regulated as an Islamic Retail Bank by the Central Bank of Bahrain' in the footer, and no person, post or date anywhere on it. So Bahrain has not been tested. The route still open is the board-of-directors profile pages of Bahrain's listed banks, reached from their own board index rather than from a search-engine query-string URL, and the CBB's own board page at cbb.gov.bh.

blanks.read: Seventeen of the 28 assigned places had no fetch spent on them. The budget went to the places where dated career material is published - Russia, Ukraine, Kazakhstan, Paraguay, Taiwan, Ecuador, Montenegro - as the assignment directs, and four of those converted. have_rd.json was read for all 28 before any search, and the existing record for each was checked against every candidate on person, episode and source URL; the four filed records share no person, employer, year or URL with anything the map holds. Nothing below is a judgement that these places are thin.

checked_not_in_assignment.note: No country outside the 28 assigned codes was searched, so there is nothing to report here. One assigned-list neighbour was deliberately not pursued: the assignment's named Pakistan lead (sbp.org.pk deputy-governor biographies) adds a record and no place, and Pakistan is not in slice B.

leads_not_opened.lead: Mega Financial Holding Company Limited's own shareholder structure or annual report, to settle whether director 董瑞斌's principal post is private, state-controlled or mixed. The CBC board CV table names the post but no ownership. If Mega's own filing gives the Ministry of Finance percentage and the listing, the record is filable with stated mixed ownership on its face.

cbr.ru/eng/about_br/bankstructute/zabotkinab, the Bank of Russia's own biography of Deputy Governor Alexey Zabotkin, was opened and gives a fully dated private-finance career before the central bank: economist at ZAO Deutsche Securities 2005-2008, managing director for investment strategy at LLC United Capital Partners Advisory 2008-2009, deputy director general at CJSC VTB Asset Management 2009-2011, deputy head of the analytical department at CJSC VTB Capital 2011-2018, then Director of the Monetary Policy Department of the Bank of Russia 2018-2020, Deputy Governor since June 2020 and a member of the Board of Directors since 21 April 2022. NOT filed because the page states no ownership for any employer - only the legal forms ZAO, LLC and CJSC, which the assignment rules out - and because two of the four employers are VTB entities, which are state-controlled and would make it a public_move. What would settle it is Deutsche Securities' or United Capital Partners' own ownership statement. Russia has a second counted record now from Alekseev, so this is depth beyond the conversion.

bank.kz/bankirs/ is a directory of per-banker biographies for Kazakhstan, surfaced twice by search and never opened; individual pages seen in results include Smagulov Askar Sagidollaevich, Nurumbet Sholpan Mukashevna and Kuanyshev Talgat Zhumanovich. Also unopened: finance.kz's report that Bekzhan Pirmatov, ex-head of ForteBank, joined the board of the Kazakhstan Stock Exchange, and bes.media's report that an ex-finance minister was approved as chairman of the board of Altyn Bank.

Kyiv Post 'The Woman Behind Ukraine's Banking Cleanup (Part II)', https://www.kyivpost.com/post/66304, was not opened; Part I was. The National Bank of Ukraine's structure pages are numbered slots (?member=N) and each other board member's page is one fetch, so Ukraine is likely to hold a third record on the same host.

produbanco.com.ec/media/709341/memoria-financiera.pdf and the 2019 memoria financiera, which in this project's experience carry a director's CV and the shareholder table in one document - the shape that converted the Dominican Republic and the Philippines.
